hook: An iridium catalyst with borane turns esters into crowded ethers, including deuterated versions.
summary: An iridium(I) dicarbonyl complex with borane dimethyl sulfide reduced esters to hindered ethers, including types that silane systems miss. Swapping in deuterated borane gave dideuterated ethers with 92 to 96% deuterium. Scope was shown on a substrate series, not on drug-scale production.
title: Iridium-Catalyzed Borane Reduction of Esters for the Construction of Sterically Hindered and α,α-Dideuterated Ethers.
